instructions: This is a .NET 7 CQRS e-commerce + vendor analytics sample. Review for security, correctness, performance, and architecture. Compare similar handlers in the same PR — flag the weaker path when one validates/paginates/authenticates and another does not. See docs/REVIEW_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md.

rules.rule: Flag SQL injection: FromSqlRaw/ExecuteSqlRaw with string interpolation or concatenated user input. Require parameterized queries or EF LINQ.
Flag handlers that call repository Add/Update without IUnitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync before returning success to the client.
Flag endpoints or handlers exposing bulk financial/PII data (exports, lists of refunds/vendors) without ApiKeyAuth or equivalent authorization.
Flag logging of tax IDs, payment/refund amounts, internal notes, or API keys at Information level or above.
Flag direct mutation of domain fields that have domain methods (e.g. StockQuantity instead of ReserveStock/AdjustStock).
Flag N+1 query patterns: await inside foreach over collections loaded from DB.
Flag Task.Run with GetResult/GetAwaiter().GetResult() or blocking on async repository calls.
Flag loading all rows (ToListAsync on full table) for API responses without pagination or reasonable caps.
Flag IMemoryCache.Set without expiration, static mutable caches, or cache keys missing entity identifiers.
Flag unbounded retry loops, empty catch blocks on external gateway calls, and webhooks dispatched before SaveChangesAsync.
Flag returning null for missing entities instead of typed NotFound/domain exceptions.
When Create/Update handlers exist in the same module, flag Update paths missing FluentValidation if Create validates inputs.
Flag command handlers mixing unrelated side effects (file write + notification + DB + cache) in one Handle method.
Flag unit tests that use Assert.True(true) or never assert the behavior under test.
